motds.body: Jump into Legends Landing and watch top Battle Royale Solos compete for the title of FNCS Champion in FNCS Solos now!
motds.title: Live - NAC - FNCS Solos Finals

motds.body: Wickedly talented Developers have brought their own horrors to life for Fortnitemares! Explore a Collection of spine-chilling Islands, each with its own twist. Face the fear with friends to unlock the Safety in Numbers Quest.
motds.title: Horrors Worth Facing Together

motds.body: Break the rules. Change the game! Activate Overrides to switch up the game and explore areas inspired by gaming legends like Sonic, Tetris, and Pac-Man as the future of the Island unfolds.
motds.title: Fortnite: Override Is Here!

motds.body: A cursed cartridge is spreading through the Island, corrupting everything it touches. Step into Battle Royale to see what hair-raising horrors await, including powerful new weapons, terrifying mechanics, horrifying bosses, and more!
motds.title: The Horror Is Here

motds.body: It's showtime! Face down animatronic bosses in Battle Royale, with one always lurking at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza Parlor. Defeat any rogue robot you find to possess the suit and finish the fight Fazbear style.
motds.title: Five Nights at Freddy's Gameplay

messages.body: Commanders, we've moved the Save the World message of the day to appear when you first log into Fortnite!
messages.title: Message of the day update
